Sr. Pre-qualification Criteria

Technical Pre-qualification criteria: Following is the Pre-Qualification Criteria: - A. Experience of having successfully completed the similar type of supply of material during la st 7 years ending last day of month previous to the one in which applications are invited shoul d be either of the following: - i. Three similar completed works each costing not less than the amount equal to Rs. 4.77 lak hs. OR ii. Two similar completed works each costing not less than the amount equal to Rs. 5.97 lakh s. OR iii. One similar completed work costing not less than the amount equal to Rs. 9.55 lakhs. B. Following documents shall be required to demonstrate experience in completion of similar works / services: - 1 1. Copy of the Purchase Order (PO) / Work Order / Contract for the similar works /services men tioned above shall be issued and executed within the last seven (7) years ending last day of month previous to the one in which applications are invited. 2. Proof of execution of the submitted PO, which may include any of the following: a. Completion certificate / Customer Acceptance Certificate OR b. GeM CRAC (Consignee Receipt and Acceptance Certificate) document OR c (i). Tax Invoice to the extent of required Pre-Qualification value and (ii). Proof of receipt of payment like bank statement for the above referred tax invoice Relaxation in Experience criteria for eligible start up is as per annexur e XI.

Financial: - A) Turnover / audited annual reports: Last three years financial audited reports or Turnover certificate from Char tered Accountant (CA) as below: Average Annual financial turnover during the last three years, ending 31st March of the previous financial year (2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25) should b e at least (Required minimum Avg. turnover of Rs. 9.55 Lakh). The Turnover should be issued by practicing CA with Membership Number, seal and signed with UDIN. Bidder shall submit audited annual reports certified by Chartered Accounta nt (CA) or Turnover certificates for above financial years. Turnover certifica tes should be issued by practicing CA with membership number, seal and s 2 igned. Certificate / document issued by Chartered Accountant will be valid and accepted only with UDIN number. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the bidder is less than 3 y ears old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account. In this case, the fi nancial turnover during last financial year / the average financial turnover during preceding two financial years should be at least Rs. 9.55 Lakh. i. Relaxation in financial criteria for eligible MSEs 1. For MSEs- Relaxation of 25% in Annual financial turnover shall be p rovided to the qualifying MSEs. ii. Relaxation in financial criteria for eligible startup as per attached annexure. Successful bidder will have to submit the Security Deposit (SD) for 5% of total con Security Depos tract value within 14 days from receipt of P.O in the form of bank guarantee as pe it r RCF format from RCF’s approved list of Bankers covering the delivery period plus 2 months. 3 SPECIAL NOTE: A) If the SD is not deposited within the stipulated 14-day period, the SD will be rec overed along with Interest from the due date of Deposit from the first payment. T he interest rate shall be the applicable Secured Overnight Financing Rate (SOFR) + 2% or MCLR (6 months) + 2% as applicable.

Payment terms for MSME Bidders: i) In respect of suppliers registered as Micro or Small Enterprises under the MSMED Act, 2006 and holding a valid Udyam Registration Certificate, payment shall be released on any one of the Tr eds Platform registered with RBI as decided by RCF. (ii) In case the Bidder has opted for discounting of the Invoice through any one of the RBI regi stered platforms then the payment will be released on such platform as decided by the Contractor. Disputes and Arbitration Clause: a. Arbitration in case of Domestic vendor In case of any dispute, difference, or question which may at any time arise between the parties hereto or a ny person claiming under them, touching or arising out of or in respect of this agreement or the subject m atter thereof shall be referred to the arbitration. Both the parties shall appoint the sole arbitrator with mut ual agreement in line with the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996. The provisions of the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996 and as amended from time to time shall apply to the proceedings conducted under t he arbitration. In case the party (parties) fail to appoint the sole arbitrator within 30 days from the date of r equest, the requesting party may approach the Court of Competent jurisdiction to appoint an Arbitrator. T he decision of such arbitrator shall be final and binding on the parties. The venue of Arbitration shall be at Mumbai. The language of the Arbitration shall be English. c. Liquidated Damages (LD): Liquidated Damages (LD) shall be applicable as per GeM ATC. Note: Both Seller and Purchaser agree that the above percentages of LD are genuine pre-estimates of the loss/damage which the Purchaser would have suffered on account of delay/breach on the part of the Seller and the said amount will be payable on demand without there being any proof of the actual loss or damag e caused by such breach/delay. d.
